decisions.reason: The official source identity is generic raw polished Oryza sativa and does not impose a long-grain-only subtype, matching the accepted RICE_GROATS_POLISHED concept better than current long-grain RICE_WHITE.
decisions.rights_use_note: The CREA page requires clear indication of the original source when data/text are copied or reproduced. Any future import must retain attribution and source/version provenance.

decisions.reason: The source explicitly classifies raw turnip-rooted parsley / parsley root and is distinct from leaf parsley.
decisions.source_provenance_note: Core macros, fiber, B1, B2, vitamin C and several minerals cite source 202; the page identifies this as Norwegian nutrient analysis of vegetables and berries. Derived fields retain their calculation-source identifiers.
decisions.api_note: Matvaretabellen exposes foods/nutrients/sources through JSON/EDN APIs, requests citation, updates annually, and states that the APIs are not versioned. A future production import therefore needs a pinned snapshot/retrieval instant rather than a mutable-current endpoint only.
decisions.market_note: PR41 found bounded Russian availability but not accepted ordinary mass-market default-pool evidence; profile-source acceptability does not close that separate gate.

market_label_evidence.limit: Retail labels support exact-form existence and macro convergence but are product labels, not by themselves a reviewed generic category-level full profile authority.

potential_full_source.note: The official site describes a full 1045-food database with extensive nutrients on a 100 g edible basis, distributed under a license agreement. FamilyFoodOS does not possess a licensed dataset in this operation, so no exact milk row or values are asserted/imported.

decisions.reason: A single or several retailer labels cannot silently become a generic canonical FoodNutritionProfile, and no reviewed accessible category-level full profile source for the exact pasteurized 3.2% identity is pinned in this operation.
